json.object_key_order: lexicographic for canonical hashing; semantic parsers must not depend on order
json.unicode: unescaped except where JSON requires escaping
json.timestamps: timezone-aware ISO 8601 instants normalized to UTC, at most six fractional digits
json.uuid: lowercase canonical string on SDK serialization

decimal.binary_float_input: forbidden for money and business outcome decimals
decimal.notation: plain base-10, no exponent, no leading plus, no insignificant trailing fractional zeroes
decimal.money_precision: up to 26 integer digits and 12 fractional digits unless a narrower schema applies
decimal.catalog_rate_precision: up to 18 integer digits and 18 fractional digits
decimal.rounding: no implicit rounding at SDK contract boundaries

revision_ledgers.duplicate: same identity and same canonical payload is idempotent; different payload conflicts
revision_ledgers.observed_at: may advance without changing the immutable economic snapshot only through a new revision

idempotency.event_identity: deterministic UUIDv5-compatible SHA-256 derivation defined by the SDK
idempotency.provider_jobs: provider, service, and opaque provider record id form durable delayed-work identity
